card.name: Partway through drug names and words
card.fires_on: Negative on a piece in the middle of a longer word, mostly parts of brand names (LEMTRADA, ANDEMBRY, HYBREZA) or split medical words. It also fires on a leading digit in a dose or weight.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Middle piece of an upper-case or split brand drug name.

modes.label: Split medical words
modes.description: Middle piece of a long word such as reconstituted, mediated, or adenosine.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: First digit of a decimal dose or weight.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a long drug name or medical word that has been split into pieces.
